title: Dedicated autoscaler: burst smoothing and utilization reporting v39
author: Evan Zhou
release_notes: Implements token-bucket smoothing for burst controls, adds per-fleet utilization reporting and dashboard; config flags for gradual rollout; backward compatible with existing autoscaler configs.
description: Context: Customers reported noisy short-lived spikes causing repeated autoscaler scaling events and noisy utilization metrics. This PR introduces token-bucket based burst smoothing and a new utilization reporting pipeline that aggregates fleet-level and pool-level metrics for Dedicated capacity. What changed: 1) Introduces TokenBucketSmoother that smooths short bursty request patterns before they affect scaling decisions. 2) Adds per-fleet utilization reporter that emits normalized_util_pct, burst_events, sustained_util_pct and sample_count to observability. 3) Adds config flags and rollout gating (feature flag: dedicated.autoscaler.v39.smoothing) to enable gradual ramp. 4) Adds dashboard and alerting queries for SLOs and spike detection. Implementation notes: Token bucket runs in autoscaler decision path and is lightweight (O(1) per request) with a small memory footprint; smoothing window and leak rate are configurable per-fleet. Reporting pipeline aggregates 10s and 1m buckets and writes to metrics backend with tags {fleet, pool, region}. Compatibility: Defaults keep previous behavior disabled; customers can opt-in via feature flag or config in Dedicated spec. Testing: unit tests for tokenbucket edge cases, e2e test against local simulator to validate no regression under sustained load, integration tests for reporting pipeline with mocked metrics backend. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to 10% of fleets for 48h, monitor spike_count decrease and false-positive scaling decrease, then ramp to 100% if metrics stable. Risks: misconfigured leak rates can delay legitimate scale-ups - hence the rollout gating and conservative defaults. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] docs updated [x] console dashboard added [x] feature flag gated rollout [x] perf bench run with 10% fleets. Related: ENG-3421 implements autoscaler smoothing, ENG-3589 adds utilization reporting.
